execution.clock: Nominal pace: {seconds} s/day at {speed}×. Hiding the page pauses the clock.
execution.performance.light: Up to 80 workers are drawn, prioritizing the camera and selection. Shadows are off and the visual mesh is reduced. All agents remain simulated. Count-based forecasting is an approximation.
execution.performance.full: Full rendering and shadows. This profile changes presentation and the initial forecasting method; the experiment seed and biology are preserved.
execution.performance.applied: Profile applied. Start another measurement to compare.
execution.performance.unsaved: Profile applied for this session; the browser did not allow the preference to be saved.
execution.performance.measuring: Measuring for 10 seconds. Keep this tab visible.
execution.performance.cancelled: Measurement canceled: the tab was hidden.
execution.performance.count: {visible} of {total} workers drawn; all are simulated.
execution.performance.report: {fps} frames/s · P95 {p95} ms · {calls} calls · {triangles} triangles/frame. Average over {seconds} s; this does not certify school hardware.
execution.advance.calculating: Calculating: {done} of {total} days; no results have been applied yet.
execution.advance.resumeHelp: Resume to reach the saved target.
execution.advance.failed: The advance could not be applied.
execution.advance.cancelled: Advance canceled. Unapplied calculations were discarded.
execution.advance.days: Choose a whole number of days from 1 to 365.
execution.advance.checkpoint: The previous checkpoint could not be preserved in the database. The advance was not started.
execution.learning.running: Training on graphs separate from the terrarium…
execution.learning.unavailable: Training is unavailable in this browser.
execution.learning.active: Learning in {colonies} colony/colonies · {decisions} local choices · {updates} individual updates. Accumulated reward: {reward}.
execution.learning.aco: ACO active. The learned policy is optional and can be compared in the same environment.
execution.learning.report: Held-out test of the initial model ({seed}): network {trained}/{episodes} deliveries · ACO {baseline}/{baselineEpisodes} · untrained {untrained}/{untrainedEpisodes}. Mean steps: network {trainedSteps} · ACO {baselineSteps}. These are training graphs; terrarium performance may differ.
